description: This file implements background I/O operations for Redis, including thread management, job queue handling, and specific background tasks such as file closing, fsync, and lazy freeing. It manages background threads, job submission, and processing, with a focus on non-blocking file operations to improve Redis server performance.

classes.name: bio_job
classes.description: Union representing a background I/O job, including file operations and lazy free functions.

methods.name: bioInit
methods.description: Initializes background I/O system, spawns background threads.

methods.name: bioSubmitJob
methods.description: Submits a background job of a specific type to the queue.

methods.name: bioCreateLazyFreeJob
methods.description: Creates and submits a lazy free job with specified free function and arguments.

methods.name: bioCreateCloseJob
methods.description: Creates and submits a file close job, with optional fsync.

methods.name: bioCreateFsyncJob
methods.description: Creates and submits an fsync job for a file descriptor.

methods.name: bioProcessBackgroundJobs
methods.description: Main loop for processing background jobs in each thread.

methods.name: bioPendingJobsOfType
methods.description: Returns the number of pending jobs of a specific type.

methods.name: bioWaitStepOfType
methods.description: Blocks until the next job of a specific type is processed, returning remaining jobs.

methods.name: bioKillThreads
methods.description: Uncleanly terminates all background I/O threads.
